comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals this sequence is most similar (94.7%) to Androctonus defensin Mol Wt: 4193.851; GRAVY: -0.47. Activity: Active against S. aureus MRSA (MIC 0.25-1 uM) and S. epidermidis (MIC 0.33-0.42 uM). Warning: other bacteria not tested. Toxicity: It had no observable effect on mammalian cell growth or morphology, on each cell DNA and on human erythrocytes. Resistance mechanism: 16 mutants from the Nebraska Transposon Mutant Library are more susceptible to peptide killing. MOA:bacteria:S. aureus: act on bacterial membranes and inhibit cell wall synthesis ( Shimoda et al., 2024). Updated 2/2024
